map.输入负载力、行程、动作时间与安全系数，选择电动执行器推力与功率: Enter load force, stroke, action time and safety factor to select the electric actuator thrust and power.
map.执行器选型：基于负载力、行程与动作时间计算所需推力/速度与功率，乘安全系数后从标: Actuator selection: from load force, stroke and action time compute required thrust/velocity and power, multiply by safety factor and pick from standard specs (screw efficiency 60 to 70%, rack-and-pinion up to 85%), for linear-motion mechanism design.
map.💡 选型推力=F×安全系数；速度=S/t；功率=F×v/η/1000: Formula: selection thrust=F times safety factor; speed=S/t; power=F times v/eff/1000.

map.📚 深度解析：执行器选型计算（推力、速度与电机功率）: In-depth: Actuator selection calculation (thrust, speed and motor power)
map.电动推杆选型：由负载力、行程与动作时间定推力档位与功率: Electric cylinder selection: from load force, stroke and action time set the thrust class and power.
map.方案比选：比较丝杠推杆、齿轮齿条与蜗轮丝杠的效率差异: Scheme comparison: compare efficiency of screw, rack-and-pinion and worm-screw.
map.节拍评估：按运动速度判断丝杠转速限制与定位精度影响: Cycle assessment: by motion speed judge screw-speed limits and positioning-accuracy impact.
map.算法：选型推力 = 负载力×安全系数；标准推力按序列 500/1000/2000: Algorithm: selection thrust = load force times safety factor; standard thrust from the series 500/1000/2000/3000/5000/8000/10000/15000/20000/30000/50000/100000 N round up (beyond rounds up to ten-thousand); motion speed = stroke / time (mm/s), also m/s;
map.= 负载力×速度(m/s)/效率/1000×安全系数（kW）。提示：速度 >50: = load force times speed (m/s) / efficiency / 1000 times safety factor (kW). Hint: speed >50 mm/s mind screw-speed limit, <5 mm/s mind positioning accuracy; action time <3 s mind motor overheating and
map.例：负载 2000N、行程 300mm、时间 10s、SF=1.5、蜗轮丝杠 η: Example: load 2000 N, stroke 300 mm, time 10 s, SF=1.5, worm-screw eff=0.7 -> selection thrust 3000 N, standard thrust 3000 N, speed 30.0 mm/s, motor power 0.13 kW, assessment: moderate speed, ample time. If load 6000 N, stroke 500 mm, time 5 s, SF=1.5, rack-pinion eff=0.9 -> selection thrust 9000 N, round up to 10000 N, speed 100.0 mm/s, motor power 1.00 kW, hint: fast speed, mind screw-speed limit. If stroke 100 mm, time 60 s -> speed 1.7 mm/s, hint: slow speed, mind positioning accuracy.
map.电机功率为什么要再乘一次安全系数？: Why multiply the safety factor again in motor power?
map.选型推力已乘过安全系数，: The selection thrust already multiplied the safety factor,
map.再乘一次是计入加速段惯性力、摩擦波动与电压跌落等因素。若电机样本已按 S1/S3: multiplies again to account for acceleration inertia, friction fluctuation and voltage drop. If the motor data already gives rated values by S1/S3 duty, the margin can be partially recovered by duty cycle, avoiding long low-load operation and low efficiency.
map.滚珠丝杠有临界转速（与丝杠长度、直径和支承方式有关），超过后会发生共振弯曲；同时: Ball screws have a critical speed (related to length, diameter and support) beyond which resonant bending occurs; also a DN limit (screw diameter times speed), usually under 70000. Above 50 mm/s, check both; if needed, increase lead or switch to rack-and-pinion.
